Keep it at regular price, but offer a discount to specific customers through loyalty reward coupons. The top 20% or so are going to be your profit, let;s say that an average supermarket cart has a 30% profit margin. The top 20% are going to have a 40% margin or so. If you increase the sales to the top 20% by 25%, for each $100 before ($40 profit), you are now bringing in $50 in profit. Maybe you have given back $10 to the customer through targeted deals, so it seems like a waste, but you have removed $20 in losses by not bringing in the customers who cost you money through only buying sale items. That leaves you with $60 in profit. a 50% increase in profit DOLLARS by using targeted sales over public sales.

tl;dr Know what your "good" and "bad" customers buy. Stop doing things that bring in "bad" customers. Do things to incent "good" customers to come back more or buy more.
